name: XIT_THREE_MA_CROSS
summary: This EA trades based on the crossover of three moving averages, generating buy signals when the fast MA crosses above both the medium and slow MA, and sell signals when the fast MA crosses below both. It uses configurable MA periods, methods, and applied prices to adapt the trend-following strategy to different instruments and timeframes. The three-MA filter aims to reduce false signals compared to a simple dual-MA crossover system.
summary_zh: 该EA基于三条移动平均线的交叉进行交易，当快速MA上穿中速和慢速MA时产生买入信号，当快速MA下穿两者时产生卖出信号。它使用可配置的MA周期、方法和应用价格，以适应不同品种和时间周期的趋势跟踪策略。三条MA过滤旨在减少相比双MA交叉系统的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于三条移动平均线的多重交叉确认，通过快线、中线、慢线的排列关系判断趋势方向。入场条件为：做多时快速MA必须同时上穿中速MA和慢速MA，做空时快速MA必须同时下穿两者，这种双重确认机制有效过滤了单交叉带来的假信号。出场条件通常依赖反向交叉信号或可选的止损/止盈设置，部分版本支持移动止损锁定利润。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金的动态手数计算，具体取决于参数配置。资金管理方面，EA提供了止损和止盈参数，但缺乏追迹止损和权益保护等高级风控功能，整体风险可控度中等。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a triple moving average crossover confirmation system, using the alignment of fast, medium, and slow MAs to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require the fast MA to cross above both the medium and slow MAs simultaneously for a buy signal, and to cross below both for a sell signal, which provides double confirmation to filter out false signals common in dual-MA systems. Exit conditions rely on reverse crossover signals or optional stop-loss/take-profit levels, with some versions supporting trailing stops to lock in profits. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-based dynamic calculation depending on parameter configuration. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameters but lacks advanced risk controls such as equity protection, maximum drawdown limits, or correlation-aware position management, resulting in a moderate overall risk control level.

pros: 三条MA双重交叉确认，比双MA系统假信号更少
参数灵活可调，支持不同MA方法和应用价格
趋势跟踪逻辑清晰，适合中长线趋势行情
代码结构相对简单，易于理解和二次开发
多重时间框架确认提高了入场质量
pros_en: Triple MA double crossover confirmation produces fewer false signals than dual-MA systems
Flexible parameters support different MA methods and applied prices for various instruments
Clear trend-following logic well-suited for medium-to-long-term trending markets
Relatively simple code structure, easy to understand and customize
Multi-timeframe confirmation capability improves entry quality
cons: 震荡行情中频繁交叉导致连续亏损
缺少追迹止损机制，利润回撤较大
止损和止盈默认为0，存在不设止损的风险
未内置资金管理模块，无法根据账户风险动态调仓
无新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓
cons_en: Frequent crossovers in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
Lacks trailing stop mechanism, resulting in significant profit drawdowns
Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, posing risk of unprotected positions
No built-in money management module for dynamic position sizing based on account risk
Missing new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same candle
improvements: 增加追迹止损功能以保护浮动利润
添加ADX或波动率过滤器避免震荡行情中的虚假信号
实现基于ATR的动态止损和仓位管理
增加新K线检查防止同根K线重复交易
加入最大回撤限制和权益保护机制
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to protect floating profits
Incorporate ADX or volatility filter to avoid false signals in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and position sizing
Add new bar check to prevent duplicate trades on the same candle
Add maximum drawdown limits and equity protection mechanisms

risk_points: 止损默认为0，未设置时单笔亏损可能巨大
缺乏新K线检查可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
震荡市场中三MA交叉频繁信号导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Stop-loss defaults to 0, single trade losses can be enormous without it
Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate position openings on the same candle
Frequent crossover signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losing trades
